_source.title: 获取 BOM 文件
_source.remarks.text.0: 可以使用 {@link SYS_FileSystem.saveFile} 接口将文件导出到本地文件系统
_source.params.filterOptions: 过滤规则，仅应包含需要启用的规则，`property` 为规则名称，`includeValue` 为匹配的值
_source.params.statistics: 统计，包含所有需要启用的统计项的名称
_source.params.property: 属性，包含所有需要启用的属性的名称
_source.params.columns: 列的属性及排序，`title`、`sort`、`group`、`orderWeight` 不传入则取默认值，`null` 代表 **无** 或 **空**

title: Get BOM file
remarks.text.0: You can use {@link SYS_FileSystem.saveFile} API export the file to the local file system
params.filterOptions: Filter rules, which should only contain the rules to be enabled. `property` is the rule name, and `includeValue` is the matched value
params.statistics: Statistics, containing the names of all statistic items to be enabled
params.property: Properties, containing the names of all properties to be enabled
params.columns: Column properties and sorting. If `title`, `sort`, `group`, and `orderWeight` are not passed in, default values are used. `null` means **none** or **empty**
